name: Henning Nyberg
bio: A twenty-five-year-old Swede who moved into Townshend House as Charles Ricketts's secretary and companion after Charles Shannon's incapacitating fall of 1929 - the last year or two of Ricketts's life. He brought a gramophone with him, and the two went out to the theatre and the cinema at least three times a week.
bio_note: Matt Cook's phrasing is explicitly hedged, 'possibly also sexual partner', and nothing in the passage settles it; Cook's endnote 149 carries his own citation and has not been chased.
